add_el_features: add element property features to a pandas DataFrame from chemical composition strings
run_add_el_features: run add_el_features on a DataFrame with an xrf comp column to extract atomic features
test_add_el_features: test add_el_features with a sample DataFrame containing chemical composition strings
refactor_add_el_features: refactor add_el_features to support a custom list of element properties to extract
review_add_el_features: review add_el_features to understand how matminer featurizers compute weighted average element properties
